scope.execution: reviewed exact function/class AST extraction with standard-library dependencies; not whole-project integration
scope.target_ownership: user-owned local repositories; HEAD blob pinned, dirty working-tree code excluded
scope.implementation_lineage_independence: PARTIAL; shared author and standard algorithm lineage not independently established
scope.known_bug_status_before_execution: DEVELOPMENT already observed in retired v1: one production mechanism and one Oracle error known; FINAL not executed and no final outcome used
scope.external_generalization_claim: actual-project QA scope only; useful source-to-target transfer and marginal benefit assessed separately

oracle_contract.authority: pre-existing function docstrings/tests and independent mathematical definitions
oracle_contract.arithmetic: Fraction.from_float exact centered variance/covariance and zero/epsilon decisions; Decimal100 only final positive sqrt conversion; existing Decimal100 Gini/weights and independent Fraction rank/count references unchanged
oracle_contract.domains: finite bounded E6 typed domains; ASCII evidence text; unique rank lists; nonnegative weights with positive total
oracle_contract.invalid_inputs: rejected before target/Oracle invocation; never fakeREFUTATION or sourceknowledge evidence; report generation/rejection counts
oracle_contract.oracle_errors: propagate as execution failure; never target bug or successful improvement
oracle_contract.failure_mechanism_count: one independent equivalence mechanism per reviewed function, not each input/seed/status
oracle_contract.positive_controls: unmodified production functions may be clean; no injected defects or expected positives manufactured
oracle_contract.normal_control_status: determined by exhaustive finite checks where feasible, otherwise no observed mismatch, not globally correct
oracle_contract.unexpected_control_mismatch: INCONCLUSIVE pending independent semantic/Oracle review; no improvement verdict
oracle_contract.correlation_degeneracy_policies: Original exact-zero and epsilon policies differ outside evaluated domain. Shared robust mathematical subset: alignedlen3..6, each series exactconstant OR exactFractionvariance>=1e-6. Compare value/computability only; no diagnostic labels. This avoids epsilon ambiguity and permits one legitimate typed contract pair without source mutation.

peer_review_corrections.jaccard_source_domain: alphanumeric+whitespace only; punctuation policy not inferred from implementation
peer_review_corrections.correlation: aligned series; compare numeric value/computability, no undocumented diagnostic-string precedence; target minimum3
peer_review_corrections.variance_ambiguity: both correlation cases restrict to exactconstant or exactFractionvariance>=1e-6; epsilon neighborhood excluded
peer_review_corrections.noise_floor: declared population-equivalence compatibility control, NOT production-defect-eligible; any mismatch makes verdict INCONCLUSIVE
peer_review_corrections.empty_conventions: Jaccard excludes any empty-token-set pair, while documentedfewerthan2prompt0 remains. FinalGini minlistlength1 excludes undocumentedempty convention; nonemptyallzero0 retained perdoc.

NativeStateful: NOT_COMPARABLE: every selected production function is stateless; no fake temporal wrapper introduced

development.hypothesis: actual native find/generate/shrink, database=None, deadline=None, 256 max_examples matching common actual-pair cap, uncached target/Oracle calls
development.E6: unmodified frozen runtime, 64 development candidates,128 native shrink predicate calls, pool128, enumeration solver, public_ir=None
development.E7: same typed spec, evidence-gated native path; at most64 guided/native search candidates plus128 native shrink calls
development.contrastive_audit: source cases only; seed101, at most64 distinct fresh proposals each; archive evidence remains DEVELOPMENT; no final source results read
development.causal_ablation: same public source cases and seed; E7 archive enabled vs empty archive; all costs reported, no tuning from outcomes

final.track: frozen public-spec plans, no final callback or labels to any Generator
final.E6: DiscoveryEngine from frozen baseline, no target IR, generate then freeze
final.E7: frozen source archive only; plan_knowledge using public spec/provenance; no final evidence assimilation
final.NativeHypothesis: native public typed strategy draw before target execution; no final feedback or shrink optimization
final.independent_replay: a discovered witness is replayed twice within the same64 pair budget; counts included
final.secret_evaluation_source: kept outside repository and never sent to Generator
final.exclusive_ledger: Atomic original pinned FINAL_TARGET_SET identity claim from sorted project/revision/path/functionAST hashes, independent of Oracle/suite/case aliases/bundle/output; manifest-adjacent START/COMPLETE ledger also retained
final.root_authorization_required: only after ten mandatory PR CI jobs and explicit code/archive/contract/suite freeze

CrossHair.runs: once per reviewed case, development and final separately, source-aware privileged tier
CrossHair.internal_symbolic_target_calls: UNKNOWN; never compared as equal Oracle budget
CrossHair.concrete_candidates: parse bounded literals only and independently replay within common domain; malformed/out-of-scope candidates rejected
CrossHair.unsupported_or_timeout: NOT_COMPARABLE or UNKNOWN, never proof of correctness
CrossHair.final_use: separate final record tier, no symbolic target information to E6/E7/Hypothesis

timing.primary: end-to-end parent-observed worker wall, includes import/source load/public spec preparation/gating/plan/IPC/evaluation/shrink/replay
timing.source_acquisition: separate one-time source read/static review/capture cost ledger; no unmeasured total human/reasoning time claim
timing.source_cost: charge full observed development+audit archive cost, report combined source+target cost and target-only
timing.memory: maximum10ms sampled live-tree RSS, not true OS peak
timing.components: measured only, overlapping components nonadditive; unavailable components UNKNOWN
timing.duplicate_evaluation_rate: duplicates across ALL actual evaluations including shrink and mandatory independent replay; not pure generation duplicate rate or wasted-search metric
timing.retired_development: v1 observed costs and posthoc API processing retained in separate ledger; never imply mission spent only v2 measured time; human/LLM UNKNOWN

verdict_rules.IMPROVED: at least one independently confirmed extra final mechanism with no detection loss and no required-method control false alert/error, OR same detection with paired median end-to-end wall ratio<=0.80 against NativeHypothesis and E6 plus actual qualified temporal/static guidance affecting at least one final discovered witness; source-inclusive cost also<=0.80; otherwise do not claim improvement
verdict_rules.qualified_zero: never IMPROVED; baseline fallback is safety/engineering evidence only
verdict_rules.no_final_failures: INCONCLUSIVE for discovery advantage; no relative first-failure metric fabricated
verdict_rules.NO_IMPROVEMENT: complete valid comparison with no preregistered marginal benefit
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: required method errors/false alerts/incomplete grid/source drift or no comparable final positives
verdict_rules.external: VERIFIED only scope-bounded actual qualified source-to-different-project useful transfer, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE if actual project execution performed; NOT_EXECUTED only no authorized safe execution

pairs.basis: same independently reviewed robust mathematical correlation subset; different original source code projects

apriori_applicability_design.qualified_utility_opportunity: APRIORI_EVIDENCE_GAP: one compatiblecontractpair does not create independent positive-and-negative development support; if no claim qualifies this study cannot test qualified knowledge utility, and no baseline fallback improvement is counted

preregistration_timing: after retired generation1 DEVELOPMENT outcomes and Oracle-only repair diagnostics; before all primary generation2 calls and any FINAL target observation

retired_generation_v1.prior_static_review_missed: finite-precision Decimal variance zero decision for exact constant floats
retired_generation_v1.source_collector: E6 only; zero source failures selected; policy unchanged
retired_generation_v1.historical_known_bug_status_before_v1_ex: NOT_MEASURED; reviewer inspected code, no target callback executed

oracle_repair_review.direct_human_approval: 독립 감사 근거를 첨부한 정상 재검토 승인
oracle_repair_review.scope: Oracle correctness only; no primary performance or generalization result
oracle_repair_review.only_correctness_deviation: exact Fraction binary-float centered variance/covariance/zero/fixed-threshold arithmetic; same Decimal100 final sqrt and same tolerance
